data.one_liner: Shelf middleware to GZIP encode HTTP responses.
data.what_it_does: Shelf middleware that automatically applies GZIP compression to HTTP responses based on content type and compression level. It skips compression for already compressed content types or small response bodies.
use_when: You are building a Dart backend using the shelf package and want to compress responses.
You want to optimize bandwidth usage for text or code content served by your shelf server.
avoid_when: You are not using the shelf package for your backend.
Response bodies are consistently smaller than 512 bytes and will not benefit from compression.
strengths: Easy integration with shelf pipelines via gzipMiddleware.
Allows customization of compression level and compression scope.
Automatically skips already compressed content types.
